idea.empty: First write your idea in one sentence.

uttu.label: Talk with Uttu
uttu.ask: Ask Uttu to change, add, shorten…
uttu.nextFilm: The next one to film is shot {n}.
uttu.allDone: Everything is filmed and in the edit.

done.added: Shot {n} added. Open it to describe it.
done.format: Every shot not yet filmed is now {format}.
done.setting: Shot {n} updated, nothing rendered: camera {camera}, framing {cadrage}. Added to the action: “{text}”.

uttu.notUnderstood: I did not catch that. Try “add a shot”, “remove shot 3”, “move shot 2 later”, “portrait”, “shorten to 15 s” or “shot 2 says: …”. Everything else changes by hand in the shot.

writer.writing: Uttu is writing… Nothing is filmed yet.
writer.reply: Here are {shots, plural, one {# shot} other {# shots}} in {scenes, plural, one {# sequence} other {# sequences}}, about {seconds} s.
writer.create: New: {names}. I create them when you film, with their quote.
writer.qFormat: I set it to landscape. Would you rather have portrait, for social?
writer.qFormatPortrait: I set it to portrait. Would you rather have landscape?
writer.note: Writing renders nothing. Nothing is sent before “Start”.
writer.failed: The storyboard could not be saved in your project. Nothing was lost: try again.

confirm.titleN: Film {n, plural, one {# shot} other {# shots}}?
confirm.lead: One after the other, in the board’s order. Nothing is sent before “Start”.

ouverture.resume: Where we are, who we follow.

detail.action: A detail that sets the mood: hands, an object, the light.

regard.action: Close on {qui}: the face, what they feel.

reaction.action: {qui} stops for a breath; something changes.

depart.action: {qui} turns away and leaves the frame.

fin.action: {lieu}, wide again: {qui} is small in the frame.

sansLieu.fin: Wide again: {qui} is small in the frame.

entry.title: Storyboard
entry.lead: Tell the story. Uttu writes a storyboard you can watch. Nothing is filmed until you approve.

ws.noShot: This storyboard has no shot yet. Add one.
ws.keyframePending: Keyframe preparation is not connected yet. Film uses the current path, with one confirmation and its estimate.
ws.missing: Missing in the project: {names}. Nothing is invented: pick a card or add a picture in the shot.
ws.exportPreview: Video export: Preview MP4 · 540p · 12 fps, originals kept.
ws.selectToRefine: Select a shot to refine its camera or action
ws.askHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. A request that names no shot applies to the selected shot.

errors.REFERENCE_MISSING: A reference picture is missing for this shot. Add it in CAST or SET, then try again.
errors.REFERENCE_AMBIGUOUS: Two cards share this name. Pick the right one in the shot.
errors.REFERENCE_CAPACITY: This shot has more references than the workflow accepts. Remove one; nothing is cut silently.
errors.REVISION_CONFLICT: This shot changed in the meantime. Nothing was overwritten: check it, then try again.
errors.LOCK_CONFLICT: This field is locked. Unlock it to change it.
errors.WORKFLOW_UNQUALIFIED: This step is not qualified yet. Nothing was sent.
errors.MODEL_INELIGIBLE: This model is not available in the current mode. Nothing was sent.
errors.QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE: The estimate expired or is unavailable. Ask for a new estimate before confirming.
errors.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Something changed since your confirmation. Check the new estimate and confirm again.
errors.BUDGET_RESERVED: Another paid step is still open, or the spending limit is reached. Nothing was sent.
errors.SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN: We could not confirm whether Comfy received this request. Check your Comfy history before sending again.
errors.PROJECT_UNAVAILABLE: The project of this result is not open on this device. The receipt is kept.
errors.OUTPUT_INVALID: The answer could not be used. Nothing was changed.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: This device could not save. Nothing was sent.
errors.INTENT_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The conversation model is missing on Comfy Cloud. Nothing was sent.
errors.PROVIDER_REFUSED: Comfy refused the request (account, credits or subscription).
errors.ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: Your Comfy account could not be identified. Reconnect it; the receipt is kept.
errors.KEYFRAME_REQUIRED: Approve a keyframe for this version of the shot first.
errors.UNDO_REFUSED: This change can no longer be undone: the shot changed since. Both versions are kept.
errors.CONTEXT_TOO_LONG: This storyboard is too long to send at once. Select a shot and ask about it.
errors.INTENT_INVALID: Uttu’s proposal could not be applied. Nothing was changed.
errors.JOB_FAILED: The render ended without a result on Comfy.

agent.title: Ask Uttu's agent?
agent.lead: One text run on your Comfy account reads this request. The board changes only once its answer is checked.
agent.costUnknown: ≈ {n} credits estimated at most (cost not measured on this account yet)
agent.sent: Sent. The board changes once the answer is read.
agent.applied: Done: the board follows the agent's answer.
agent.failed: Uttu's agent could not do this. The board is unchanged.

write.lead: Write or paste it. Type @ to bring in your characters and places. I turn it into a storyboard you can watch. Nothing is filmed until you approve.
write.label: Your story
write.placeholder: A night, two people, one place, and the thing one of them carries.
write.cost: One reading on your Comfy account.
write.limited: Without a Comfy account, understanding is limited.
write.tip: Tip: you can paste a full script with shots and dialogue. I keep your words.

work.asking: Asking Uttu on your Comfy account
work.fallback: Uttu could not read that. The text was split on this device. Understanding is limited.
work.noCast: No named character from your Cast
work.split: Splitting it into {n, plural, one {# shot} other {# shots}}
work.dialogue: Keeping your dialogue, adding camera moves

plan.facts: {shots} shots · {seconds} s · {characters, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} · {places, plural, one {# place} other {# places}}
plan.sketch: Sketch · replaced by the real frame
plan.close: Play it, ask for any change, or approve it to film.
plan.keptLines: I kept your story and your {n, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} of dialogue.
plan.keptWho: {names} look the same in every shot.
plan.empty: This board has no shot yet.

ask.undone: Undone. The board is back as it was.
ask.doneClose: Done: shot {n}, “{title}”, is now a close-up. Same place, same characters, same length. Nothing else changed.
ask.doneAll: Done: I applied “{text}” to every shot. Story, characters, place and dialogue stay the same.
ask.doneNote: Done: I noted “{text}” on {where}. Nothing was removed or moved.
ask.doneOne: Done: I applied “{text}” to shot {n}. Story, characters, place and dialogue stay the same.
ask.added: Added shot {n} at the end. Nothing else was filmed.

film.title: Film
film.rule1: Shots are filmed one after the other, from your Comfy account.
film.rule2: You can stop between shots. A shot already filming always finishes.
film.rule3: Each finished shot appears in its card. Your edit opens when all are done.
film.filming: Filming shot {n}. The next ones wait.
film.stopped: Stopped after this shot. What was already filming will finish.
